## Findings / decisions

- **Registry assembly:** writer modules declare their columns beside the writer
  (`compartments.RIGHTS_BLOCK_SPECS`, `placement.PLACEMENT_COLUMN_SPECS`,
  `transparency.*_SPECS` beside each `*_FIELDS`, `statements.STATEMENT_COLUMN_SPECS`,
  `source_licences.SOURCE_LICENCE_COLUMN_SPECS`,
  `shaping` JURISDICTION/SHARING_EDGE/FRESHNESS spec tuples beside the `as_json`
  writers, `spine_export` SITES/RECORD_CLAIMS/LABELS/COVERAGE beside the emit
  seams). `column_registry.py` aggregates them into `COLUMN_REGISTRY` — one
  resource per emitted table/stream; `assert_documented` fails the build on an
  undocumented column or unregistered resource.
- **Scoping (recorded):** "every emitted column of every artifact" binds where
  the artifact is columnar (bundle tables + `.jsonl` streams + the
  `sources.json`/`freshness.json` row documents). Aggregate JSON documents
  (`web/dossiers.json`, `web/map.json`, analytics, …) are schema-versioned
  documents — the dictionary lists them with their `sig.*` schema ids and
  descriptions, not per-field: per-field registries for nested documents are
  what their `sig.*/N` row schemas carry. The fail-closed gate covers every
  artifact the manifest can classify as row-bearing.
- **datapackage v2:** the bundle's `datapackage.json` is regenerated at the
  spine layer over the FULL extended artifact set (the J1 NEW-11 28-artifact
  gap — every manifest artifact listed, tabular ones carrying `schema`). The
  publication-bound fields (`version`=publication_id, `created`=activation
  instant) land on `releases/<pub>/datapackage.json`, emitted by `activate()`
  (activation time is unknowable at export build — recorded, not stubbed).
- **catalog.jsonld:** emitted at export root (per-bundle DCAT 3 catalog:
  DatasetSeries + one Dataset per compartment + Distributions with
  path-relative downloadURLs + `prov:wasGeneratedBy` the export run) and
  re-emitted for the whole series at activation as `releases/catalog.jsonld`
  (absolute downloadURLs on the canonical origin; `dcat:previousVersion`
  chained across activated releases). `releases/` is inside the publish
  allow-set; no new staged-root name needed.
- **provenance.jsonld:** `SpineExport` gains `provenance_jsonld` beside
  `provenance.ttl`; the same validated graph serialised JSON-LD then
  canonical-JSON-normalised for byte stability. `prov:hadPrimarySource` added
  to `provo.build_prov_graph` — full-URL lane → the upstream URL entity;
  host-only lane → a `sig:upstream/<host>/<path-sha>` entity; withheld lanes →
  no triple (honest absence, S-6 unchanged).
- **Baseline:** clean tree at `335e1b98`; baseline `make check` run recorded
  below before edits.

## Phase 2 — implementation notes (delta since plan)

- `column_registry.resource_for_path` classifies row-bearing paths by stem for
  every serialisation — `.jsonld` included (`<table>.jsonld` is the flattened
  row serialisation, not a document). `.jsonld` is deliberately absent from the
  fail-closed set (`_ASSERT_EXTENSIONS`): an unmapped `.jsonld` stem
  (`catalog.jsonld`, `provenance.jsonld`) is a linked-data DOCUMENT, never a
  column-bearing table — the fail-closed posture lives in `assert_documented`
  at write time for the table itself.
- `validate_release`'s undeclared-file set gained the two activation metadata
  files (`releases/<pub>/datapackage.json`, `catalog.jsonld`) — emitted after
  the integrity manifest like `release.json`, external to the hash cycle by
  construction. The ops publish-verify `overlay_ok` allowlist gained the same
  three entries plus the series `releases/catalog.jsonld`.
- The post-cutover probe fixture gained a `route:` capture for
  `/data/` (404 — the bare prefix is a namespace, mirroring `/artifact/`;
  only `/data/dictionary/` is a page).
- Sitemap: the catalog loc moved from `/releases/catalog.jsonld` (a
  release-pipeline artifact never present in the web build — the e2e resolvable
  -and-self-canonicalising contract cannot hold for it) to a web-served copy at
  `/data/catalog.jsonld`, copied byte-for-byte from `<exportDir>/catalog.jsonld`
  in export mode only. A fixtures build carries no catalog and lists none —
  the sitemap never names a URL the emitted tree will not resolve (QW-11).
- `frictionless.data_package` accepts `Mapping` (covariant) for
  `schema_by_path`/`sources_by_path` — mypy invariance fix.
- A "Data dictionary" nav entry under Reference was tried and reverted: nav
  hrefs are root-absolute literals counted by the path-containment baseline
  (P36.66a — shrink-only, growth needs a contract amendment). The page
  remains discoverable via the sitemap and the linked-metadata surface.

## Phase 3 — self-review (two passes)

Pass 1 (code): re-read every diff hunk. Fixed in review: (a) the uncommitted
`jsonld` misclassification meant `devices.jsonld` carried no `schema` link —
closed by the stem-lookup change above; (b) the `P.staged_revalidates` /
`V.digests` failures showed activation metadata lands post-manifest — closed by
the `external`/`overlay_ok` additions; (c) ruff format/E501/E741/F822 +
`__all__` hygiene; (d) mypy `dict`→`Mapping` covariance. The lazy
`COLUMN_REGISTRY` `__getattr__` keeps writers importable without a cycle;
specs sit beside each writer (`*_SPECS` tuples in compartments/placement/
shaping/source_licences/statements/transparency/spine_export/bundle_io).
Pass 2 (contract): walked every deliverable + AC row against the tree. The
fail-closed gates cover all four emit seams (bundle tables, spine streams,
transparency writers, manifest paths). Metadata lands in the `metadata`
compartment (CC-BY-4.0), manifest-listed + digest-pinned — it cannot bypass
rights/compartment gates. `prov:generatedAtTime` reads `retrieved_at`; the
DCAT/PROV IRIs mint on `surveillancegraph.org` bases (no `sig-project.org`).
Zero inline `<script>`/JSON-LD — links only (D-J3-7).

Known limits (recorded, not stubbed): staging-verified AC — no staging env

namespace prefix, not a page (mirrors `/artifact/`). The sitemap lists the
catalog only in export-mode builds — a fixtures build has no catalog to name.
